description: The pair of nested-priority-whole-alternative on B D T A. Here the longer c → B D is followed by T A, a whole [T A]. So leaving [T A] out after c → B is forbidden, and begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%elidable T
%rule text B D T A
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r c [T A] D
%rule c B | B D
